svg.title: The commit-msg hook that rejects 'update stuff' — and the --no-verify that strolls past it
svg.desc: A commit message hitting a checkpoint gate: a well-formed commit passes through to the right, a garbage 'bad' commit marked with an X bounces off, and a dashed --no-verify path arcs up and over the gate to bypass it entirely. Trace Bloom generative banner for “The commit-msg hook that rejects 'update stuff' — and the --no-verify that strolls past it”. A manhattan lattice probed by 2 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 823460633.
